newsitem.title: GREECE: NATL MORTGAGE BANK SETS BOND RATE AT 10.40PCT.
newsitem.headline: NATL MORTGAGE BANK SETS BOND RATE AT 10.40PCT.

text.p: National Mortgage Bank set the gross rate on its bonds maturing July 1997 to 10.4 percent, it said in a statement.
National Mortgage Bonds expiring July 31 may be rolled over at a gross rate of 10.4 percent provided they have been issued less than five years ago, it said.
Bond returns are subject to a 15 percent witholding tax, it said. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
